title.id: Zenith 2.0 (5 Nov): cocok dengan data game 1.9.0.2

id: Data terjemahan disesuaikan dengan update game 1.9.0.2 (5 Nov). Setelah game di-update sampai lobi, cukup tekan Suntik Data.
Event baru Blind Box Highlight Emote Heluo Hitam Putih ikut diterjemahkan: aturan, Pecahan & Token Heluo, deskripsi emote tiap hero, varian tersembunyi.
Teks kartu/talent & skill baru (Wu Zetian, Zhuang Zhou, Arthur, Bian Que, Marco Polo, dll.) dan kartu Diamond Frenzy diperbaiki.
Masih Mandarin: badge faksi di pop-up kartu, gambar nama taktisi di judul Lineup, dan tugas mingguan Battle Pass.
en: Translation data updated for game update 1.9.0.2 (Nov 5). After updating the game to the lobby, just press Inject Data.
The new Monochrome Heluo Highlight Emote Blind Box event is translated: rules, Heluo Shards & Tokens, per-hero emote descriptions, hidden variants.
New card/talent & skill texts (Wu Zetian, Zhuang Zhou, Arthur, Bian Que, Marco Polo, etc.) and Diamond Frenzy cards fixed.
Still Chinese: faction badges in the card pop-up, the tactician name image in the Lineup header, and Battle Pass weekly tasks.
